serviceEquationSource.purpose: Bottom-up engineering/service workload model for the 19 ASK telecom systems. It links work objects, roles, man-hours, events, trips, OEM cash cost and selling-rate logic.
serviceEquationSource.control: REUSE METHOD — REBIND PARTICULAR INPUTS. PJ2608-0553 equations/rates are methodology or historical calibration only unless separately adopted for 0550.
serviceEquationSource.keyRule: Unknown / OWNER OPEN / TBC inputs do not become zero and must not be force-allocated to match a lump-sum allowance.

serviceEquations.control: I=0/1 only when scope is established; ownership is separate. Unknown is OPEN, not zero.
One row per work-object family/role; review, revision and document-control effort must not overlap.
Calendar presence; no blanket document-review multiplier on PM. Site work is separate.
Count each controlled interface edge once; do not create N² duplication.

serviceEquations.equation: MD = Events × Days × Crew; MH_attend = MD × H_day
serviceEquations.control: Attendance hours govern pay/invoicing. Productive efficiency must not reduce paid attendance.
Use only for output-driven work and check access/crew caps.
Internal cost rate must be an explicit loaded rate; do not reverse-engineer payroll from selling rates.

serviceEquations.equation: C_trip = Fare + Hotel + PerDiem + Transport + Permits + Insurance + Other
serviceEquations.control: Count once per physical trip; shared FAT/training travel is not duplicated.

serviceEquations.equation: C_service = C_labor + C_trip + C_OEM + C_test + C_other
serviceEquations.control: Goods/installation by others remain outside; deduct OEM inclusions only with evidence.

serviceEquations.equation: P_service = Σ(MH × R_sell_hr) + Σ(MD × R_sell_day) + P_other
serviceEquations.control: Hourly/day-rate and cost-plus bases are alternatives where applicable, not automatically additive.
Markup and gross margin are different quantities.
Keep prime layer separate from ADDVALUE cost/margin.

serviceEquations.equation: w_s = Driver_s / ΣDriver; Allocated_s = Pool × w_s
serviceEquations.control: Use a causal driver. No equal split across 19 systems by default.
Retest cost depends on cause and entitlement.

serviceEquations.equation: MH_train = Sessions × Days × Trainers × H_day + PrepMH + CloseMH
serviceEquations.control: Trainees are not trainers. PAGA/CCTV have three trainee categories of five in the recovered model.
FX requires controlled source/date; historical FX is not automatically current.
Purchase quantity/spares/pack rounding do not automatically create installation labor.

requirements.rule: Telecommunication cargo estimated import-permission lead time 4–5 months.
Communication equipment requires Communications Department / MOTC approval before MOC import licence; working duration 2–3 months.
After Communications Department approval, MOC import licence follows general-cargo procedure and can take another 3 months.
For applicable exploration/development project imports, allow roughly another 3 weeks for Duty & Tax Exemption Certificate after import licence.
Import licence and customs-clearance applications are submitted through PTTEPI FaFE.
VHF/SSB/walkie-talkie require radio licence and radio frequency application at PTD.
NDB and air-band transceivers require DCA approval.
Communication equipment other than personal mobile phones is not allowed to be imported by hand carry.
